name: record names
summary: Every record carries a name of one to three words chosen by the agent that writes it, describing its contents; the name is appended to the record, needs no check against other names, and does not affect the numbering of the id prefix.
statement: All records are appended with 1 to 3 words of the name writing agents choice representing the contents of the record. This appended name does not require conflict avoidance and does not interrupt the ID prefix progression
context: Written by the commander under a Commander Response heading inside XX-001, beside CA-047 and CA-048. Applied by the pilot as a name field on the record and the same words appended to the file name after the id, as missions already do (M001-cockpit-setup.md); records filed before this advice keep their bare id file names until a clerk renames them.
